title: Grade 6 Ratios and Rates
description: Easy-to-hard lesson across Ratios and the next unit, Rates, then a short drill and the first percents skill.

ramp.label: Level 1
ramp.description: Most items at low D with a gentle ramp.

questions.prompt_latex: \text{There are 4 green apples and 3 purple apples. Write the ratio of green to purple.}
\text{There are 2 green books and 1 orange books. Write the ratio of green to orange.}
\text{A student reads 4 pages in 2 minutes. At the same rate, how many pages in 4 minutes?}

metadata.instruction_latex: \text{Find the unit rate or an equivalent rate.}
